mentions.description: An AI-powered mock interview tool for system design interview preparation, currently in beta with free access offered in exchange for feedback.
mentions.problem: Interviewees spend a lot of time revising and learning system design material, but struggle to put that knowledge together when designing a system during the actual interview.
mentions.audience: Prep candidates for interviews, who spend time revising and learning material but struggle to apply it when designing the system they are given in the interview.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on ai interviews for system design prep.
